facts.fact: Meera infers from the two ropes that Asha's four are two bound pairs who each spoke their true names at the Shilak Cairn, and that someone paid them enough to do it.
Rohan wonders aloud who knew his route, saying it was chosen for him and only a handful saw it.
Meera tells a small lie to Rohan ('I don't care a fig for the shelf'); her right fingertips whiten for an hour and Rohan reads it from her hand.
